about: VG-CLI-COLLECT-DOCTOR-INIT: the command lines of collect, doctor and init (18.112), run by verification/gates/cli_options_check.py the same way as VG-CLI-OPTIONS's cases.json, whose 'about' defines the fields. Each option is read or refused with a key: init no longer takes --non-interactive, doctor refuses --project beside --write-errors, an empty value is refused, never read as the default, and a dry run with --out writes the plan and its manifest. The three commands are Python only, so TypeScript and Java answer every row with cli.not_implemented.

cases.why: TypeScript and Java do not implement collect, doctor or init (Python only, documented in docs/reference/commands); porting them is not yet an item, and the port removes this override
